summary: DietPi is a stripped-down Debian operating system tailored specifically for single-board computers. It provides an administrative interface to help you install and configure various home server software packages without manual command-line setup.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users running single-board computers who want a lightweight base system and a streamlined method to set up self-hosted services.
watchOut: Because it modifies standard Debian foundations heavily to achieve its minimal footprint, troubleshooting unusual hardware or software issues might require familiarity with its specific custom scripts.
deployNotes: As an entire operating system image rather than a standard containerised application, deployment typically requires flashing the image directly to an SD card or eMMC storage for your target single-board hardware.
